talk: ^Do you see that Rie? I think we found the source of our blockage.
^So Bo, do you think your delivery's in there?
^It'd take a bit of lookin', but I'm sure it's gotta be one of em.
^Ah! A little thing like this is nothing!
^Besides, sweet as you all have been, you've already done more than enough.
^Why, after this I bet I could have this whole place sprucened up by tomorrow!
